Bernstein, Esq., 110 East 59"h Street, New York, NY 10022 ("Transferee"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS Transferor is the owner in fee simple of certain real property, with the of New York, known as Lot 27 in Block 697 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, Count y of New York and as and by the street address 507 West 25th Street,New York,New York, and more Lot"); WHEREAS Transferee is the owner of certain real property, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as Lots 1, 9 and 18 in Block 700 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and as and by the street addresses282-298EleventhAvenue,529-545West28thStreet,and517-527West28th Street, New York, New York, and more particularly described in Exhibit “B" annexed hereto and WHEREAS the Transferor Lot is a "granting site", as defined in Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (hereinafter, the "Zoning Resolution") and the Transferee Lot is a "receiving site", as defined in Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution; WHEREAS, pursuant to the provisions of Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution, Transferor and Transferee have notified the Department of City Planning of the City of New York of their intent to transfer 9,875 square feet of floor area from the Transferor Lot to the Transferee Lot (the “Transfer Floor Area"); and WHEREAS, Transferor and Transferee desire to transfer the Transfer Floor Area to the Transferee Lot. NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of ten ($10.00) dollars, lawful money of the United States, and other valuable consideration paid by Transferee, the receipt and sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged: Transferor does hereby transfer, convey, distribute and assign to Transferee and its successors and assigns forever, 9,875 square feet of floor area, as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution, together with all development rights appurtenant thereto, the Zoning Resolution. - 1 - KL3 2670278.2
